parsed_json.up: Select target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence for all single-protein targets. Join target_dictionary to target_components on tid, then to component_sequences on component_id. Filter target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Map target_chembl_id from target_dictionary.chembl_id, target_name from target_dictionary.pref_name, target_type from target_dictionary.target_type, protein_accession from component_sequences.accession, protein_sequence from component_sequences.sequence. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence.
